text:
Type: pair of grey velvet curtains
Use: darkening and dressing windows; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: contemporary, classic, glam
Materials: heavy velvet with a soft sheen, metal ring grommets
Colors: medium cool grey, silver rings
Shape: two long straight panels with a grommet heading on a rod, deep regular folds, plush matte surface, heavy drape and strong visual weight
Feel: cozy, rich, enveloping
Goes with: white or grey walls, dark wood, brass accents, velvet sofas; contemporary or classic living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: SANELA
product.description: The thick curtains darken the room and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing into the room.
